inputs.text: Bill C-12 received royal assent on March 26, 2026, tightening immigration and asylum rules in ways that put people seeking safety—including Nigerians—at greater risk. Calling migration a security problem shifts the costs of political decisions onto people with the least power to bear them. That’s not protection; it’s a failure of institutions to uphold people’s rights. Canada should safeguard refugees, not deepen their vulnerability.
